name: accelbyte-ai-plugins
description: Public AI coding agents, skills, and MCP servers for AccelByte.

AGS_API_MCP_URL.title: AGS API MCP Server URL
AGS_API_MCP_URL.description:
Your AGS environment's MCP endpoint. There is no shared default — set the URL for your own deployment.
Public Cloud: https://{studio}-{game}.prod.gamingservices.accelbyte.io/mcp/{studio}-{game} (the {studio}-{game} namespace appears in both the host and the path).
Private Cloud: https://{environment_name}.accelbyte.io/mcp.

TEAMMATE_MEMORY_MCP_URL.title: Teammate Memory MCP Server URL
TEAMMATE_MEMORY_MCP_URL.description:
Your AGS environment's teammate memory endpoint. Fill your own domain into the shape below, keeping the {studio}-{game} segment.
Shape: https://{env-domain}/teammate/memory/mcp/{studio}-{game}
Every AGS environment serves this; if yours does not answer yet, contact AccelByte.
Leave empty if you have not been given one; the teammate scans and reports without memory.

TEAMMATE_WIKI_MCP_URL.title: Teammate Studio Wiki MCP Server URL
TEAMMATE_WIKI_MCP_URL.description:
Your AGS environment's teammate studio wiki endpoint. Fill your own domain into the shape below, keeping the {studio}-{game} segment.
Shape: https://{env-domain}/teammate/wiki/mcp/{studio}-{game}
Every AGS environment serves this; if yours does not answer yet, contact AccelByte.
Leave empty if you have not been given one; nothing else degrades.
